messages:
alex: short proposal: tighten postmortem followups with a small SLA gate + ownership handoff so remediations don't go stale. idea: required 24h quick-check, mid SLO nudges, and a visible handoff when IC rotates.

beth: sounds good. what SLA gate are you thinking?

alex: suggestion: P1 = 14d, P2 = 30d, P3 = 90d. SLA gate = if ticket >50% of SLO without verification -> auto-escalate to oncall-lead and create a blocker card. also require owner + acceptance criteria at PM publish.

cheng: +1. also propose a one-line ticket template so people actually fill it.

alex: tiny template suggestion:
```
Remediation mini-ticket:
- Owner: @name
- Priority: P1/P2/P3
- Acceptance: one-line + link
- 24h check: status / blocker / next action
- Target SLO: 14d/30d/90d
```

ops-bot: i can schedule reminders: `@ops-bot followup <ticket-id> 24h 50%SLO verifyDue` -> pings owner and oncall-lead. ops needs JIRA integration enabled.

oncall-lead: rotation note: prefer 2-week IC slots starting Mon 09:00 UTC. primary owns followups; secondary covers weekends and handoffs at swap. roster published in playbook.

beth: can we add a simple metric: remediations reopened % and repeat-component count (90d)? alert when repeat >=3.

cheng: agree. also add rule: if owner marks "Blocked" twice at checkpoints, ops-bot auto-creates unblock ticket and escalates.

alex: plan: i'll open a brief PR with the template, SLA gate, ops-bot command examples, and rotation cadence. if no objections in 48h we'll run a 2-week pilot limited to P1 incidents.

beth: +1

cheng: i'll help wire the dashboard alert.

ops-bot: tip: use `@ops-bot preview <ticket-id>` to simulate reminders before enabling.

alex: thanks all  goal: fewer orphaned remediations and faster detection of recurring components.
